name: web2ipa
description: 把网站包成 iOS .ipa — Capacitor 壳 + Xcode archive + 手动 Payload 打包

scripts.ios:archive: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
scripts.ios:all: npm run ios:sync && npm run ios:archive && npm run ipa:pack
